core_obligations: Reduction (proof lines 5447-5448): the lower shriek of the sheafification of the presheaf is rewritten as the sheafification of the left Kan extension, using the companion result.

Computation of the left Kan extension (proof lines 5448-5461): the companion result on sheafifying inside the composite reduces this to the sheafification of the left Kan extension of the given presheaf, whose values are computed as the displayed coproduct over the morphisms into the localizing object, with the obvious restriction mappings.
proof_roadmap: Rewrite the lower shriek using the removal of the sheafification.
Move the sheafification inside the composite using the companion result.
Compute the values of the left Kan extension as the displayed coproduct.
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives an explicit description of the lower shriek of the sheafification of a presheaf on a localized site: it is the sheaf associated to the presheaf whose value at an object is the coproduct, over the morphisms from that object into the localizing object, of the values of the given presheaf (statement lines 5431-5444). The proof is a complete computation: the lower shriek is rewritten using the removal of the sheafification for simultaneously continuous and cocontinuous functors (proof lines 5447-5448); the companion result allows the sheafification to be moved inside, reducing the assertion to the values of the left Kan extension (proof lines 5448-5449); and those values are computed as the displayed coproduct with the obvious restriction mappings (proof lines 5450-5461). The non-formal content is the computation of the left Kan extension. The claim is H2: a computation in two steps with each input named.
